The '''Rust Yards''' was an industrial area located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], near the [[River Lands]] and the [[Eastern Grime]].<ref name="TOR" />

The Rust Yards consisted of many factories that had been constructed, operated and eventually run to the ground yet over the decades had only been rebuilt and repurposed. The region consisted of ore refineries which had become [[Droid/Legends|droid]] recycling plants once the ore supply ran out or where weapon assembly lines became toxic chemical storage bays once arms dealing slowed down.<ref name="TORC" />

By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Rust Yards were under the control of [[crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], due to the fact that he held the largest armed force in the area. However, a series of brutal attacks shifted the control of the Rust Yards to Nem'ro's rival [[Voontara Fa'athra]], who then kept the area locked down with his own [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]].<ref name="TORC" />
